Requiring parental notification or consent is not legally necessary and would discourage care. A consensual relationship with a 17-year-old partner does not by itself indicate abuse that must be reported. Referral would only delay treatment.
explicacao_pt: Nos EUA, todos os estados permitem que o adolescente consinta sozinho com diagnóstico e tratamento de IST (alguns fixam idade mínima, em geral de 12 a 14 anos). A clamídia é tratada com doxiciclina 100 mg de 12 em 12 horas por 7 dias, com sigilo, tratamento do parceiro e nova testagem em cerca de 3 meses.
fonte: Workowski KA et al. Sexually Transmitted Infections Treatment Guidelines, 2021. MMWR Recomm Rep 2021;70(4):1-187.

vinheta: An 81-year-old man is in the intensive care unit 5 days after a large left middle cerebral artery stroke. He is intubated, does not respond to voice, and lacks decision-making capacity; the neurology team considers meaningful recovery very unlikely. Two years ago he signed a durable power of attorney for health care naming his longtime friend as his health care agent. He did not write a living will. The friend reports that he said many times he would not want to be kept alive on machines if he could no longer recognize people, and she asks the team to transition to comfort care. The patient's only daughter, who has not seen him in several years, arrives and insists on tracheostomy and full treatment.
pergunta: Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?

alternativas.texto: Follow the decision of the daughter as next of kin
Follow the decision of the designated health care agent
Have the ethics committee make the treatment decision
Obtain a court-appointed guardian before any change in care
Wait for family consensus before changing treatment

explicacao: When a patient lacks capacity, decisions are made by the surrogate the patient chose. A legally designated health care agent (durable power of attorney for health care) takes precedence over next of kin in the default surrogate hierarchy and should use substituted judgment, applying the patient's known wishes. The friend's report of his repeated statements about not wanting prolonged life support is the best available evidence of those wishes. The physician should meet with both, explain the prognosis, and acknowledge the daughter's distress, but her preference does not override the agent's authority. An ethics consultation can help resolve conflict, but the committee advises and does not decide. A court-appointed guardian is needed only when there is no valid surrogate or when the surrogate appears to act against the patient's interests. Waiting for consensus would continue treatment the patient said he did not want.
explicacao_pt: O procurador de saúde nomeado pelo paciente (durable power of attorney for health care) tem prioridade sobre os familiares e decide por julgamento substituto, com base nos desejos conhecidos do paciente. O comitê de ética aconselha e media conflitos, mas não decide.
fonte: AMA Code of Medical Ethics, Opinion 2.1.2 (Decisions for adult patients who lack capacity) and Opinion 5.2 (Advance directives).

vinheta: In a randomized, double-blind trial, 4,000 adults aged 55 to 75 years with no known cardiovascular disease and elevated cardiovascular risk are assigned to a new lipid-lowering drug or to placebo (2,000 participants in each group) and followed for 5 years. Myocardial infarction occurs in 80 participants in the drug group and in 120 participants in the placebo group.
pergunta: Based on these results, how many patients need to be treated with the drug for 5 years to prevent one myocardial infarction?
explicacao: The event rate is 120/2,000 = 6% with placebo and 80/2,000 = 4% with the drug. The absolute risk reduction is 6% minus 4% = 2% (0.02), and the number needed to treat is 1 divided by the absolute risk reduction, 1/0.02 = 50 patients over 5 years. The value 33 comes from confusing the relative risk reduction (2%/6% = 33%) with the NNT. The value 25 is the reciprocal of the event rate in the treated group (1/0.04), 17 is the reciprocal of the placebo event rate (1/0.06), and 100 would correspond to an absolute difference of 1%.
explicacao_pt: A redução absoluta de risco é 6% menos 4%, ou seja, 2%, e o NNT é 1/0,02 = 50 pacientes tratados por 5 anos para evitar um infarto. A redução relativa de risco (33%) não deve ser confundida com o NNT, que vem sempre do inverso da diferença absoluta.
fonte: Laupacis A, Sackett DL, Roberts RS. An assessment of clinically useful measures of the consequences of treatment. N Engl J Med 1988;318:1728-1733; Celentano DD, Szklo M. Gordis Epidemiology, 6th ed. Philadelphia: Elsevier; 2019.
